item.title: Parking sign faded on Canada street, 10th November
item.description:
The sign reads "Mon - Fri, 8.00am - 6.30pm, Permit holders (H) or Pay by phone", but the lower half, including the pay by phone wording and number, is now largely erased. About a month ago it was clearly legible and showed the pay by phone details with a location number. The sign is on lamp column 404 09. A second pole on the same street shows similar fading. Both poles also now have a green Southwark PayByPhone plate showing location 89096, with chargeable hours of Mon to Fri 08:00 to 18:30 at £5.70 per hour.
